all_class_presence.sql: SELECT 'at_raw_picks' AS table_name,asset_class,COUNT(*) AS n FROM at_raw_picks GROUP BY asset_class UNION ALL SELECT 'at_signal_outcomes',asset_class,COUNT(*) FROM at_signal_outcomes GROUP BY asset_class

limitations: No raw_payload or credentials fetched or persisted. No trading_picks or strategy_perf_by_class query.
OPEN is database bookkeeping, not proof of executable/current/eligible picks.
Class labels retained as stored; no symbol-based reclassification or cross-table row identity reconciliation.
No raw-pick deduplication, net-cost adjustment, signal validity check, or production gate replication.
Full-history aggregates are bounded to at_raw_picks and at_signal_outcomes; all recent windows end at the fixed snapshot time.

cohort_definitions.snapshot: Repeatable-read consistent snapshot of InnoDB tables; database UTC_TIMESTAMP and NOW matched. No reliance on metadata row estimates for exact counts.
cohort_definitions.recent_windows: Inclusive [snapshot minus interval, snapshot]; 48h=2 DAY. Signal/recorded/closed timestamps are separately counted; NULL never qualifies.
cohort_definitions.raw_stale_open: status=OPEN AND signal_timestamp < snapshot - 7 DAY; missing signal timestamps counted separately
cohort_definitions.geometry: Strict positive entry/TP/SL; LONG: TP>entry>SL; SHORT: TP<entry<SL. An indicative sanity screen, not a replication of production gates.
cohort_definitions.recent_open_proxy: OPEN, signal within last 7d, strict geometry, no closed_at, was_stale/was_banned/was_demoted coalesced to zero; explicitly NOT an executable-pick designation.
cohort_definitions.outcome_recent_source_union: opened_at OR closed_at OR created_at within 30d; distinct from closed-at-only recent outcome counts.
cohort_definitions.raw_recent_sources_symbols: signal_timestamp within 30d; no symbol-based class remapping.
cohort_definitions.missing_class: No group row means exact zero rows in that table for the stored class label.
